name: controller-toolbox
description: Production-grade discrete-time control library (C++20, Eigen3). Covers PID -> LQR -> MPC -> Hinf -> MRAC -> TubeMPC -> ParticleFilter -> DeePC -> ILC -> SINDy -> KoopmanEDMD -> L1Adaptive -> CBFSafetyFilter -> GaussianProcess -> EchoStateNetwork -> NeuralPID -> CEM-MPC -> BayesianOptimizer -> GeneticAlgorithm -> DifferentialEvolution (~85 algorithms). Full pybind11 Python bindings included.

python-bindings.description: Build pybind11 Python bindings (ctrl_toolbox Python module)
